quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of mental preparation and visualization
quotes.excerpt: When you are nervous, it means you haven't done enough work.
quotes.quote: I've already envisioned myself. There's so much visualization. When you are nervous, it means you haven't done enough work. And Kobe said that. That's definitely something I agree with. When you are ready, you're not nervous. When you're nervous, that means you're not ready. I'm ready.
